measurements.heading: Welcome to Styld
measurements.body: This tour follows your client account. You will see how discovery, comparison and planning work today, and where live booking is still unavailable.

measurements.heading: Discover Nairobi
measurements.body: Browse looks, salons and independent professionals across Nairobi. Use these tabs to switch between what you want to see.

measurements.heading: Neighbourhood Filters
measurements.body: Narrow results by neighbourhood, price and service mode. Filters apply to the category you are viewing.

measurements.heading: Salons and Professionals
measurements.body: Open a salon or professional profile to see the services and details shown there. Discovery listings currently include sample profiles while the marketplace is prepared.

measurements.heading: Compare Services
measurements.body: Compare up to four catalogue services by provider, price, duration and description. This catalogue view is separate from your Plan, where the shortlist holds up to three providers. Values are demonstration data, not live quotes or availability.

measurements.heading: Plan Before You Commit
measurements.body: Use Plan to review a selected service and provider in one place. This is a planning preview only. Booking requests, appointments, confirmations and payments are not live yet.

measurements.heading: Home and Updates
measurements.body: Home brings discovery and supported account updates together. Appointment history is not shown because live bookings are not available yet.

measurements.heading: Profile and Preferences
measurements.body: Manage your account details and preferences from Me and Settings. You can replay this client tour from Settings or Help at any time.
